 Introduction 
 This module provides speech to text for input & Text area fields.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 The installation of this module is like other Drupal modules.

 
 Copy/upload the speech_to_text module to the modules directory. 
 Enable the speech_to_text module in Extend . 
 
 ( /admin/modules )

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Configure your Drupal input selectors on the following page:

 /admin/config/systems/speech-to-text
